notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value zero.
description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying zero {E}, sacrificing Returned Pastcaller, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Returned Pastcaller's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Returned Pastcaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
